notes.title: DUCKS DROP feat. Divine Galactic Duck
notes.content:
Hi!
Our first drop is now out!
It features a lot of new ducks our artists designed. There's a new rarity called Divine and with that a first divine duck - Galactic Duck that is full animated!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068294/906587fe6492f7a779bc64d98daa6a6f65df4f29.png

There are also some questions about the future of the game we received and wanted to share some more insight.

What will be the next update?
Next update will probably be a smaller one that will feature a craft event. Players will be able to obtain some craft-only ducks for a limited time!

What's next in the future?
Next we plan a big overhaul of the game. That also involves changing the game engine because we feel like Unity is limiting our design. As we said. We want there to be more to the game than just clicking and that is why we will be taking the whole game to Unreal Engine 5 as soon as possible, so there is less to port than in a couple of months.

What about the performance?
We will ensure that the performance will stay as good as possible, but the game will probably be a little more demanding than previously. In our opinion this is a good trade off. We get a lot more features to play with and can ensure the longevity of the game, and at the same time, sacrificing little to nothing.

Is this an "NFT scam"?
We get this comment a lot. Our reviews balance around Mostly Negative to Mixed. This truly breaks our hearts and the team thinks we should've waited with the release longer, so there would be more unique features. The game is out now though, so there is nothing we can do apart from apologize to those who expected more and ask to wait a little longer. As we said multiple times. There is a lot to come, and with that...

What will be the new features planned for the future?
Not to spoil too much, but we will be reworking the crafting system. It will now revolve around 3 classes that each player will be able to choose from. Those classes will each have unique ways of buffing your regular duck drops. You will also be able to trade with other classes so you could benefit from their buffs. Each class will have 10 levels that will unlock new recipes and items the further you progress.
We will also be adding some minor features like being able to change the duck that displays in game, some click effects and full clicker mechanics (auto-clickers etc.)

To wrap things up
We are truly thankful for this amazing first week of our game. Of course there are some not so amazing things that happened, but the team is really in good spirits and we are motivated to work more on the game, so you can see our true vision of the project. We can't wait to show you more features and most importantly even more... cute... DUCKS!

See you in the pond,
DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)!

notes.title: Drops Hotfix Confirmation
notes.content:
With a lot of backend stuff that needed to be sorted out we can now confirm that drops are working correctly.
Please download the update and restart your game for the fix to work and for some to receive their duck reward after a shortened delay.

This is our first Steam game, yet we already received a lot of positive feedback.
Thank you for understanding and see you in the pond,
DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)!

notes.title: DUCKS Launch Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi!
We encountered a bug that prevented some players from receiving the right amount of ducks for their playtime. With today's update we believe we found and solved the issue.
Now everyone should be getting the right amount of ducks and some people will experience a tremendous boost to their drops.

See you in the pond,
DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)!

notes.title: DUCKS GLOBAL RELEASE
notes.content:
Long awaited DUCKS is finally out!
Hop in the game now for a chance to receive a Launch only duck!
This event will last for three days only!

We have a lot of updates and features already in the works. Those features include:
- class system - different classes will boost your duck drops in different ways
- crafting system - craft items to boost your progress and drops
- leveling system - level through 3 classes to unlock new items and ways to boost your progression, quality and quantity of items dropped

We are VERY excited to finally release our game and can't wait to work on it further!

See you in the pond,
DUCKS Team (Comfy Studios)!
